name: Kindle Portal
description: Kindle e-ink dashboard: live agent state monitor and cognitive map visualization. Served at /kindle/ on the gateway HTTP port for Kindle's experimental browser.

enabled.description: Master toggle. When false, no HTTP routes are registered and the service stays dormant.

accessToken.description: Optional shared secret. When set, non-loopback HTTP requests must carry ?token=<value>. Loopback (127.0.0.1 / ::1) is always allowed.

refreshIntervalSeconds.description: Monitor page XHR polling interval in seconds. Floor of 15 enforced for e-ink refresh compatibility.

mapRefreshSeconds.description: Map page meta-refresh interval in seconds. PNG rendering is expensive; keep >=60.

scope.description: Which user's persona to visualize on the cognitive map. 'last-active' picks the most recently updated session; 'specific-user' requires userId.

userId.description: Required when scope='specific-user'. Feishu open_id format (ou_xxx).

showWiki.description: Overlay knowledge-wiki concept/entity nodes on the cognitive map when a vault exists.

maxDomains.description: Maximum persona domain nodes to render on the map. Top by strength; rest are noted as truncated.

pngWidth.description: Rendered cognitive map PNG width in pixels. 758 fits Kindle Paperwhite viewport.
